# Runtime dependency record

Inspected on 2026-10-26. The application uses no runtime network service.

| --- | --- | --- |
| `com.github.bhlangonijr:chesslib:1.3.7` | `a5ac968a30bc91bee4a19d24981c40815d5140bde518524fef2a3679f965ad31` | Apache 2.0 |
| `org.apache.commons:commons-lang3:3.18.0` | `4eeeae8d20c078abb64b015ec158add383ac581571cddc45c68f0c9ae0230720` | Apache 2.0 |

chesslib resolves through JitPack. Its [tagged POM](https://github.com/bhlangonijr/chesslib/blob/1.3.7/pom.xml)
declares Commons Lang 3.18.0 as its sole runtime dependency and targets Java 11.
The resolved chesslib JAR has no LICENSE or NOTICE entry. Its license text
comes from the [official tagged license](https://github.com/bhlangonijr/chesslib/blob/1.3.7/LICENSE).
The [tagged Board.java](https://github.com/bhlangonijr/chesslib/blob/1.3.7/src/main/java/com/github/bhlangonijr/chesslib/Board.java)
supplies the preserved author copyright. Commons Lang's LICENSE and NOTICE
are exact byte copies from the resolved artifact's `META-INF` entries.
The runtime notice files are also copied into `src/main/assets/licenses/`.

## Rules acceptance evidence and limit

The adapter admits only exact UCI strings generated by chesslib's legal-move
list. `doMove` alone and the library's combined `isDraw` are not authorities.
The adapter separates threefold/50-move claims from fivefold/75-move automatic
draws, keeps replay history, and checks mate first.

The library's `isInsufficientMaterial` classifies K+N versus K+N and K+B versus
K+N as draws. Legal cooperative mating sequences can exist for those material
sets. The adapter therefore uses conservative verified patterns: bare kings,
a single bishop or knight against a king, and bishop-only positions where all
bishops occupy the same square color. Two knights against a king remain active.

**Accepted first-version limit:** general dead positions (for example a fully
blocked pawn structure where no legal sequence can ever permit mate) are not
detected by chesslib or this material filter. Full FIDE dead-position coverage
is not established. On 2026-10-26, the parent explicitly accepted this limit for
the first version. Do not claim complete standard chess adjudication.

The `verifyChessLibraries` Gradle task checks both JAR hashes before `preBuild`.
It also rejects any additional runtime artifact until that artifact is reviewed.

The easy opponent evaluates at most 256 candidates and checks a 100 ms deadline
between library calls. It always retains a legal fallback. An individual Java
library call and OS scheduling cannot be forcibly bounded to 100 ms; this is a
cooperative computation budget, not a real-time wall-clock guarantee.

No rating, learning-effect, age-suitability, emulator, or physical-TV claim follows
from JVM unit tests.
